changes.evidence: Past group told on screen: in S2E18 'The Frenemy of My Enemy' Cal tells Skye 'I was in China volunteering for Doctors Without Borders... I was supposed to be there for two weeks, but I met your mother.' Under the settled rule a past group told on screen is a stage keyed to the person's first title, placed first.

(1) Past employer told on screen: in S3E18 'The Singularity' Simmons says he was lead researcher at the GT Agrochemical lab they raided and 'was asked to step down a month before' (company named on screen in S3E16 'Paradise Lost'). (2) Forced service: in S3E18-S3E21 Hive's Inhumans kidnap him and he works for Hive's HYDRA (town bought with Malick's HYDRA money, HYDRA volunteers for his Kree experiment, he makes the Primitives) until S.H.I.E.L.D. takes him in at the Pacific missile silo in S3E21/22. Marvel Database lists Hydra as a former affiliation.

Past group shown on screen in S3E8 'Many Heads, One Tale' (his file): Giyera enlisted in the U.S. Marine Corps at 18, served with a peace-keeping task force in Somalia, and was honorably discharged before private security work and recruitment into HYDRA by Malick. Past group goes first, keyed to his first title. Marvel Database lists 'US Marines' (formerly).

In Slingshot ep 4-6 ('Reunion', 'Deal Breaker') Ramon, jailed for corruption after S3E11 and escaped, is no longer a police officer ('Me and my companeros were the law!') and only SELLS a stolen 0-8-4 to the Watchdogs (Briggs) with his own men; he is a vendor/ally, never a Watchdog. Under the owner's rules an ally or one-job deal doesn't count. Marvel Database lists only the Colombian Police (the MCU wiki lists Watchdogs, but its own text describes only the sale).

The group ends: in S4E20 'Farewell, Cruel World!' Aida leaves the Framework for her human body (Ophelia), and in S4E21-22 she starts the Framework's deletion, which erases the Framework and its HYDRA. Afterwards she acts alone (only an uneasy ally of Ivanov) until Coulson kills her in S4E22. Same pattern as a group that ends with no departure recorded.
